title.narrative: Sida-NEFCO Consultant Cooperation Fund for Eastern Partnership: EaP

description.narrative: The intervention's intended outcome is to by 2020 have agreed on financing for 8 projects with investments worth 40 million EUR. By 2020, 8 projects should also be implemented. The expected environmental benefits in terms of reduction phosphorous discharge to recipients (ton/yr) and reduction of CO2 and other climates gases (ton/yr) will be determined and reported on a project by project.

Insatsen rör upprättande och finansiering av en fond för konsultstöd med syfte att identifiera, förbereda, genomföra och/eller utöva tillsyn på projekt inom området miljö och energieffektiviseringar i länderna i det Östliga Partnerskapet, dvs. Belarus, Georgien, Moldavien, Armenien, Ukraina och Azerbajdzjan, med fokus på Belarus, Georgien, Moldavien och Armenien.
Sida-NEFCO Östliga Partnerskapet Konsultfond stöder projekt inom både offentlig och privat sektor. Inom den offentliga sektorn, som dominerar, gäller stödet t.ex. kommunal infrastruktur med en tydlig reformagenda och med minskade föroreningar eller andra miljövinster som resultat. Inom det privata gäller stödet insatser inom i första hand jordbruks- och banksektorn. Investeringarna ska i båda fallen vara inte bara miljömässigt utan också tekniskt och finansiellt sunda.
Georgien och Moldavien har associeringsavtal med EU med omfattande miljöåtaganden. Detsamma gäller Ukraina vars stora behov sedan 2008 täcks av en konsultfond med ett syfte och arbetssätt som i princip är identiska med den föreslagna fondens. De övriga partnerskapsländerna tillämpar approximering till EU:s regelverk. Bland dessa har Vitrysslands behov hittills täckts genom en separat konsultfond. För att uppfylla högt ställda miljökrav på minskade utsläpp behövs i alla sex länder stora investeringar i t.ex. rening av avloppsvatten, avfallshantering, energieffektivisering i bostäder och offentliga byggnader.
NEFCO har ramavtal med länderna inom Östliga partnerskapet, med undantag för Moldavien och Azerbajdzjan. Ramavtalet med Moldavien förväntas bli klart i början av 2017. Därmed fungerar NEFCO som en internationell finansiell institution i länderna och tillämpar t.ex. för upphandling ett regelverk som är internationellt godkänt.
Insatsen genomförs under perioden 2016 - 2020 och beräknas till totalt 30 000 000 SEK, med en första utbetalning på 10 000 000 SEK år 2016.

preparatory and implementation support (consultancy assignments) for environment and enery projects

title.narrative: Agreement between Sida and NEFCO on the EaP Consultancy Trust Fund
Beslut om insats - NEFCO konsultfond för Östra Partnerskapsländerna

description.narrative:
The implementations of projects that were expected to materialize thanks to the provision of Sida financing to this trust fund has been much slower than originally expected. One of the main reasons for this is that progress on the development of projects in Belarus have been halted. NEFCO investment projects in the water and waste water sector in Belarus were the most advanced projects when this trust fund was established in 2016. Since then feasibility studies had been finalised, NDEP capex grants had been approved, and NEFCO had negotiated with the Belarusian authorities on how to structure the NEFCO loan for investments in upgraded waste water infrastructure in 2 Belarusian cities. Following the political developments in Belarus after the presidential elections in August 2020 and the Russian invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, these projects have been put on hold.
The invasion of Ukraine has also put a lot of restraints on Nefco as an organization. Nefco has traditionally worked a lot in Ukraine, but in order to diversify its activities this regional Eastern Partnership fund was established in 2016. However due to the war again all attention has been on Ukraine and it has been difficult for Nefco to focus on the other countries.
Most notable progress in the trust fund so far has been experienced in Moldova where NEFCOs energy efficiency programme is in demand and various activities have been ongoing. During 2023 another project in Moldova was approved with the focus on identifying new energy saving projects. The Goverment of Moldova appreciates Nefco being the only IFI to provide municipal lending and want these activities to expand. A public event was held in Chisinau where Nefco together with E5P presented the Energy Savings Credit Facility. A study has been performed by a local consultancy firm. As a result of the consultants work five new project proposals were prepared and presented to Nefco by the end of 2023. The proposals relate to energy efficiency modernization of educational facilities in the local communities of Moldova and the proposed measures include thermal modernization of building envelopes, switch to biofuel, solar energy installations, etc. Nefco further assessed the proposals and considers them having good potential to be developed into feasible projects and be then presented for approval and allocation of financing by Nefco and E5P decision making bodies.
In January 2022 Sida provided no-objection to use EUR 72,500 from the Sida-Nefco Consultant Cooperation Fund for Eastern Partnership to finance PIU Support services in relation to Nefco-E5P Programme Energy Efficiency Refurbishment of Healthcare Institutions in the Republic of Moldova. The allocation was used to finance a contract with local consultant Sinergetica Consulting LLC (Sinergetika, the Consultant). Sidas support was crucial to enable smooth and efficient support to the implementation of these investments.
The referred Programme consists of four separate projects in the districts of Telenesti, Nisporeni, Floresti and Ialoveni. At present two projects, in Telenesti and Nisporeni, have been completed. The E5P has contributed with grant funding to the implementation of the projects and the E5P donors visited the clinics in June 2025. Floresti is close to completion. Unfortunately, as has been reported several times, most recently at the E5P Steering Group in Chisinau in June this year, the implementation of the project in Ialoveni is severely delayed and its practical implementation has not yet started. After several rounds of negotiations with the new leadership of the district, the projects is now fully on track to proceed with the implementation. Corresponding decisions extending the availability of the financing have been taken by Nefco and E5P.
In Armenia there was no progress on this concept and Nefco has not spent resources on Armenia during 2023 or 2024.
In Georgia it has also been difficult. The project "Energy Efficiency Improvements in Public Schools in Mountaineous Regions" with a total financing of 6.5 MEUR (NEFCO loan 3.9 MEUR and E5P grant 2.6 MEUR) was signed during 2022. When completed it is expected to lead to reductions of CO2 emissions of 1 900 tons/annum. The project is ongoing, but delayed and the aim is now only to complete the project according to committed agreements. No other projects have been initiated. Georgia has during the last years had a quite beneficial financial situation and has financed most smaller projects from their own budgets.
The target of 8 projects have been achieved, but the size of the projects are smaller than anticipated and not all have been implemented in the end. The main learning from this is that municipal projects take much more time than expected and with a turbulent political situation it takes even longer. Another learning is that when international consultants are combined with local consultants, usually the end results becomes better due to the combined experiences.
